notes: Polished feedback + Japanese coverage. (1) Pop-up browser alerts are gone: the app now uses subtle in-app toasts for messages, and invalid Pexels/Pixabay URLs or empty searches show a small red note right under the field instead of a blocking 'localhost says' dialog. Technical error text no longer gets dumped at you. (2) The Background framing controls (Video/Image framing, Fit, Scale, Speed, Clip, Audio, Muted, Ken Burns, Brightness/Contrast, overlay Opacity/Radius/Softness) are now fully translated, so they read in Japanese when the app is set to 日本語. (3) Removed leftover debug logging.
